source.name: USGS National Hydrography Dataset — High Resolution

note: Approximate USGS river-course overview, not a recommended navigation channel. Sandbars and branch choices vary. Exact landing connections are not mapped; published 9.4-mile guidance is retained separately.

review.reviewer: Float ETA agency guide and satellite imagery review
review.note: Twelve overlapping views cover the retained course. The named USGS line follows visible river bends and one channel around islands; it is not necessarily the widest or deepest branch. Localized sandbar and bank offsets remain. Saved source was fetched October 30; broader network refresh requests timed out, so no claim of a complete alternative-channel review is made.

overviewReview.routeReview: Approximate mapped river course. Branches, sandbars and small bends can differ from current conditions. The Boscobel ramp connection and the short Big Green River approach into Woodman Landing are not drawn; confirm both before floating.
overviewReview.note: Approximate river bends. The Boscobel ramp connection and Woodman’s Big Green River landing approach are not shown; use the separate access markers.

putIn.note: The line begins in the mapped river about 182 metres from the Boscobel West ramp; no straight ramp connector is drawn.

takeOut.note: The line ends in the Wisconsin River about 271 metres from the Woodman area. The Big Green River landing approach is not mapped.

acceptedIssues.endpoint-offset-over-100m: The source course omits the two landing connections described above. Source-backed access markers remain independent; no GPS time remaining or distance adoption is enabled.
